messages:
Mira: Quick note - hit duplicated ops in staging when token rotated mid-request. starter-kit retried on 401 and we applied the same generate twice.
Sam: can you paste the minimal repro?
Mira: flow: call /v1/generate -> auth expires -> refresh -> client retries original payload -> backend sees same op twice. log: `req#12: 401 -> refresh -> retry -> 200` then `req#13: 200` for same logical op.
Jon: does starter-kit set any idempotency header?
Sam: only for create endpoints; streaming/text endpoints are currently unguarded.
Mira: proposed fixes: 1) add Idempotency-Key header for logical ops (uuid4) 2) client LRU replay cache to avoid instant replays after refresh 3) server-side short replay window (default 8s) keyed by Idempotency-Key.
Sam: also switch to exponential backoff with jitter. current deterministic backoff causes small thundering herds on refresh storms.
Jon: agree. also emit telemetry `replay.suppressed` when server dedupes so we can tune ttl.
deploy-bot: deployment queued for branch/mira/replay-fix - CI: 2/3 passed (lint failing).
Mira: i'll push a small README snippet and a unit test that simulates token rotation + assert side-effect count == 1. tagging @Sam for header naming parity.
